'''Riyado Town''' (Japanese: '''リヤド村''' ''Riyado Village'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive small village located among the mountains of [[Izabe Island]] in [[Hoenn]].

It appeared in ''[[AG107|Absol-ute Disaster]]''. The town is home to {{OBP|Gordon|AG107}} and his younger brother {{OBP|Nicky|AG107}}. For a long time, the locals believed a {{pkmn2|wild}} {{p|Absol}} was putting the town under a curse and causing them many problems, including destroyed bridges. However, Gordon, {{Ash}}, and {{ashfr}} discovered the Absol was actually trying to warn them of an imminent flood coming from the area's water source, an underground spring. As a result, the town was saved, and Absol was forgiven.

==Places of interest==
[[File:Square Top Izabe Island.png|thumb|left|200px|Square Top]]
===Square Top===
Square Top is the highest peak on [[Izabe Island]], named for its cube-shaped summit. The surrounding area is a rugged mountain with an underground spring running through it.

Square Top also marks the center of {{p|Absol}}'s territory.
